# DELETE /api/v1/users/{username}/tokens/{token}

Delete an access token by ID or name

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** basic_or_reverse_proxy+token · **ID:** `ep-166`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| username | path | string | True |
| token | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — Not self or admin
- **404** — Token not found by ID or name
- **422** — Multiple tokens match the given name

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.DeleteAccessToken | controller | Parse path param as int64; If 0, lookup by name; Delete by ID |
| 2 | [models](../modules/models.md) | db.Find[auth_model.AccessToken] | repository | Find tokens by name for user (only if ID parse fails) |
| 3 | [models](../modules/models.md) | auth_model.DeleteAccessTokenByID | repository | DELETE from access_token WHERE id=? AND uid=?; Check affected rows == 1 |

| Store | Type | Operation | Description |

| [access_token](../datastores/databases.md#access_token) | database | SELECT | Lookup token by name (if not numeric ID) |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Delete token accepts both numeric ID and string name as identifier | business_logic | Path param cannot be parsed as int64 |
| Multiple tokens with same name causes 422 error on delete-by-name | validation | Name lookup returns more than 1 token |
| Token endpoints require self or admin access (reqSelfOrAdmin middleware) | authorization | Authenticated user is not the target user and not admin |
| Token endpoints require basic auth or reverse proxy auth (not token auth alone) | authorization | Request uses only token-based authentication |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Token ID or name doesn't exist for user | 404 | not found | False |
| Multiple tokens share the same name | 422 | multiple matches for token name | False |

### Error Paths

- **Name lookup returns 0 results** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **Name lookup returns >1 results** → ctx.APIError → 422
- **DeleteAccessTokenByID returns ErrAccessTokenNotExist** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
